en.name: John IX
en.summary: A pope who convened councils formally banning any future posthumous trial of a deceased pope, closing the door on further Cadaver Synod-style scandals.
en.body: John IX held synods at Rome and Ravenna that confirmed Formosus's rehabilitation and explicitly prohibited any future trial of a pope after death, a direct response to the trauma of the Cadaver Synod a few years earlier. His reign brought a degree of stability rare for this turbulent period in the papacy's history.
